items.title: OKX and ICE set a November 23 launch for their tokenized stock venue under the SEC exemption
items.why: Derek says stocks are coming to Freehold, and this venue shows both the SEC route for tokenized shares and how many issuers refuse to have their stock tokenized.

items.title: Securitize plans to buy River One to add asset-backed finance to its tokenization business
items.why: Securitize competes with Freehold for issuers, and pairing tokenized assets with stablecoin lending is a credit layer Freehold does not offer yet.

items.title: Morgan Stanley buys digital transfer agent Vinyl Equity as a tokenization building block
items.why: Big banks are buying the shareholder registry layer to capture issuers at listing, the same issuer onboarding position Freehold's Tokenization Studio is trying to win.

items.title: ARK files for a tokenized market infrastructure ETF
items.why: ARK's proposed fund would back listed tokenization platforms, the category Freehold competes in, but it would not hold network tokens like RIO directly.

items.title: Groma's tokenized real estate goes live in a permissioned Uniswap pool
items.why: Groma competes with Freehold for real estate issuers, and a public trading venue for permissioned property tokens is the secondary liquidity Freehold still has to build.

items.title: Morgan Stanley among the first banks to tokenize US stocks and Treasuries via DTCC
items.why: Wall Street is tokenizing on its own private rails, which validates the model Freehold sells but shows the biggest issuers may not need public-chain platforms like Realio.
